summary: Pro Caption Editor redesign verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass (auth guards, preset CRUD + ownership isolation, font upload/list/download/delete with size/type validation + isolation, project list projection privacy, ProjectEdit persistence for caption_groups & editor_style, cross-user 404 isolation). Frontend: authenticated with existing owner iter4.mediab.1786098208077@example.com, opened seeded project_c0af42d2ab1e from Recent Sessions, exercised the full Pro editor at 1920x800/980x850/720x900. All 20 templates, all 25 curated fonts render; custom TTF upload+delete works via FontFace endpoint; My Presets save/apply/delete + ownership isolation confirmed; caption list panel shows 40 short (1-4 word) phrases with editable text; timeline click-to-seek moved video to 2.307 s, playhead updates, canvas rescales with zoom (3026->7636 px at 256%), waveform shows 180 speech-derived bars, video/audio/caption/time tracks & ruler are all visible, caption block drag +60 px, right end-handle resize (width 128->168 px), split increments group count then merge decrements, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y round-trip the count. Space toggled playback (paused true->false), safe-zone toggle works, Right inspector controls (family, weight 500, size 64, B/I/U, alignment, X/Y sliders, Apply to all) respond, explicit Save state resolves to 'Saved', autosave and PUT persistence round-trip (GET returns caption_groups=40 with full editor_style). Responsive: at 980 px inspector correctly hides from grid and reappears inside the Style-tool drawer; no horizontal page overflow at 1920/980/720. No webpack overlay or React runtime errors. Loaded ai-testing-core skill; no real Whisper/LLM/render calls were spent (existing rendered project reused per handoff). Only real gap: 1 of 40 caption groups currently has 1 word (min<2) - a minor phrase-grouping quality issue, not a blocker.

issues: 1 of 40 phrases contains only 1 word ('gaya'-like). Grouping heuristic should either merge single-word groups with a neighbour or extend the minimum to 2 words where speech gaps allow.

action_items: Consider tightening the phrase grouper so caption groups do not fall below 2 words (currently 1/40 groups is a single word - LOW priority, purely a content quality improvement).
No blocking action items - the redesign is stable and ready to ship.
critical_code_review_comments: editor_assets.py POST /fonts strips underscores/dashes from the family display name; if a user's uploaded font legitimately contains an underscore in its trade name it will be flattened. Acceptable given custom fonts are user-facing labels but worth documenting.

editor_assets.py /fonts/{id}/file returns raw bytes with content_type from DB - fine, but does not set Cache-Control/Content-Length; FontFace loads still work but a Content-Length header would help @font-face preloading.

captions.py ProjectEdit round-trip preserves caption_groups/editor_style but does not validate that group.start<=group.end or that word_indices are unique/sorted. A malicious PUT could create out-of-range groups (not exploited in tests but worth adding a Pydantic validator).

ProTimeline uses `.timeline-canvas` inline-styled width tied to duration*zoom; renders correctly but there is no memoization on _waveform_peaks - large videos re-derive on every navigation. Acceptable at current media length.
CaptionListPanel input for group text has no maxLength - a user could paste tens of thousands of characters into a 2-5 word group. Consider soft cap ~120 chars.
